Dahua 2.5-inch DH-SSD-C800S256G SATA 256GB SSD

The Dahua 2.5-inch DH-SSD-C800S256G SATA 256GB SSD is a reliable and high-performance storage solution designed for laptops, personal computers, and other PC client devices. Built with advanced technology, it delivers excellent speed, durability, and efficiency for everyday computing tasks. With a sequential read speed of 500MB/s and sequential write speed of 400MB/s, this SSD provides quick data access and reliable performance for everyday applications, such as booting up your system, launching programs, and transferring files. Its 4KB random read and write speeds of 37,000 IOPS and 57,000 IOPS further enhance its responsiveness, making it ideal for tasks that demand fast data processing. The 256GB capacity provides ample space for operating systems, software, and personal files, ensuring smooth multitasking without the need for constant data management. The SSD’s 3D TLC storage media technology balances speed and endurance, allowing for long-lasting performance with a TBW (Total Bytes Written) rating of 60TB. For durability, the Dahua DH-SSD-C800S256G offers shock resistance (up to 1500G at 0.5ms) and wide temperature tolerance, operating between 0°C and 70°C, and storing safely between -40°C and +85°C. The drive also supports TRIM, Garbage Collection, and SMART monitoring, ensuring optimized performance and longevity over time. The SSD is powered by the Marvell 1120 controller, providing efficient management of data flow, and it features low power consumption with a maximum of 1065mW during active use and 400mW in idle mode. With a 3-year limited warranty, the Dahua 2.5-inch DH-SSD-C800S256G offers a solid, cost-effective storage solution for those seeking reliable and fast storage for their devices. It is an excellent choice for both everyday users and professionals seeking to enhance their system’s performance.

Features of Dahua 2.5-inch DH-SSD-C800S256G SATA 256GB SSD

  • High-Speed Performance: Up to 500MB/s sequential read and 400MB/s sequential write speeds for faster data transfer.
  • Reliable & Durable: Supports TRIM and SMART information viewing for optimized performance and longevity.
  • Strong Build Quality: Withstands 1500G impact and 10Hz~1000Hz vibration resistance, ensuring durability.
  • Low Power Consumption: Consumes only 1065mW max and 400mW in idle mode, making it energy efficient.
  • Broad Compatibility: Works with laptops, PCs, and personal computers using a SATA interface.
  • Efficient Storage: Uses 3D TLC NAND storage media for reliable performance with 256GB capacity.
  • Compact & Lightweight: 2.5-inch form factor, with a net weight of just 40g, making it easy to install.
  • Extended Lifespan: TBW of 60TB ensures long-term reliability, backed by a 3-year limited warranty.
